follow_on_changes.gate: owner approval plus required review before implementation
follow_on_changes.intent: Define project traceability, lifecycle, evidence, Reads/Amends, and new-task Verify conventions.

follow_on_changes.gate: display/hardware review and independent physical evidence
follow_on_changes.intent: Own responsive layout and the complete feed-to-physical-screen acceptance chain.
non_goals: making the panel an alarm dependency
inferring physical acceptance from process health
rewriting display source documents in the audit

follow_on_changes.gate: domain/safety review and fresh executable evidence
follow_on_changes.intent: Specify received, spooled, durable, drained, committed, published, live, stale, and unknown states.
non_goals: changing storage identity outside accepted amendments

follow_on_changes.gate: per-change owner disposition and specialist review
follow_on_changes.intent: Map retained legacy task plans to requirements, scenarios, tasks, and evidence through companion changes.

follow_on_changes.gate: explicit owner approval and reviewed publication change
follow_on_changes.intent: Publish approved current capabilities under openspec/specs only after authority and evidence reconciliation.
non_goals: creating canonical specs merely to satisfy validation

follow_on_changes.gate: all required task Verify commands exit 0 and owner closure is recorded
follow_on_changes.intent: Archive only changes whose current evidence, Verify results, review, owner decision, and regressions are reconciled.
non_goals: using archive to hide validation failures
